_note: Entrance examinations whose ranks this system refuses to check — the X1
The reason is fairness and it is not negotiable per-deployment: JEE and similar
cutoffs vary enormously by reservation category, and a category-blind comparison
systematically flags reserved-category candidates for a rank that is entirely
valid. Build it with correct per-category tables, or not at all.
This is DATA rather than code for one reason only: the list is regional. An
Indian CV names JEE and GATE; a different market names entirely different
examinations, and the same fairness argument applies to them. What must never
become data is the ENFORCEMENT — the names are matched against the claim's own
verbatim, in code, because a prompt is not an enforcement mechanism. qwen3:4b,
told explicitly to ignore JEE ranks, returned them anyway; qwen3:1.7b returned
them relabelled as `codeforces`, which no label-based filter can catch.
